name: tr_og
caption:
IF OG ANUNOBY HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🌙 Absol: said to bring disaster, but it has a calm disposition. Pick 23 in 2017, 16 points in his first start
💍 Murkrow: loves anything shiny, will even try to steal rings. An appendectomy kept OG out of the 2019 run, and he still got the ring
⏳ Dialga: it controls time. Game 3 vs Boston in the bubble, OG at the buzzer: 104-103
🦡 Sneasel: smart and sneaky, steals from nests. Led the NBA in steals in 2022-23, 1.9 a night
🔄 Karrablast: only evolves in a trade. December 2023: OG to New York for RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley
🛡️ Zamazenta: the legendary shield. 2 All-Defensive teams. In New York now: 16.7 a night through 10 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If OG Anunoby had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF OG ANUNOBY HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Absol. People say it brings disaster, but it's actually got a calm disposition. We took OG twenty-third in twenty seventeen. First career start: sixteen points.
beats.dlg: IT HAS A CALM DISPOSITION.|PICK 23. FIRST START: 16

beats.vo: Murkrow. It loves anything that sparkles. It'll even try to steal rings. Twenty nineteen: an appendectomy kept OG out of the whole run. He still got the ring.
beats.dlg: IT'LL EVEN STEAL RINGS.|MISSED THE RUN. GOT A RING

beats.vo: Dialga. It has the power to control time. Game three against Boston, in the bubble. OG, at the buzzer. A hundred and four to a hundred and three, and we're not down three-oh.
beats.dlg: IT CONTROLS TIME ITSELF.|G3 AT THE BUZZER: 104-103

beats.vo: Sneasel. Smart and sneaky, it steals from nests while the parents are away. In twenty twenty-three, OG led the whole league in steals: one point nine a night.
beats.dlg: SMART AND SNEAKY.|LED THE NBA: 1.9 STEALS

beats.vo: Karrablast. It only evolves when it gets traded for a Shelmet. December twenty twenty-three: we sent OG to New York for RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley.
beats.dlg: IT EVOLVES IN A TRADE.|TO NEW YORK FOR RJ + IQ

beats.vo: And the ace. Zamazenta. A legendary warrior that fights with a shield. Two All-Defensive teams. Today in New York: sixteen point seven a night through ten games.
That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Anunoby: selected 23rd overall by Toronto in the 2017 NBA draft; first career start 14 November 2017 vs Houston, 16 points; early April 2019 emergency appendectomy, missed the entire championship playoff run, dressed for the Finals but did not play as the Raptors won the 2019 title; 3 September 2020 game-winning buzzer-beating three in a 104-103 win in Game 3 of the East semifinals vs Boston, preventing a 0-3 deficit; NBA steals leader 2022-23 (2023) with his first All-Defensive selection; 2 All-Defensive Second Teams (2023, 2026); 30 December 2023 traded to the New York Knicks for RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley

Absol: 'in actuality, this Pokemon possesses a calm disposition' (Moon); Murkrow: 'It will even try to steal rings' (Ruby); Dialga: 'It has the power to control time' (Diamond); Sneasel: 'A smart and sneaky Pokemon' (Platinum); Zamazenta: Warrior Pokemon, ability Dauntless Shield (PokeAPI species/pokemon)
Karrablast evolves into Escavalier by trade for Shelmet (PokeAPI evolution chain)
